name: softube-tape-lofi
description: Lo-fi / vintage-character tape via Softube Tape — a creative effect, NOT mastering-grade. Type C (dirtiest), slow 3 3/4 IPS (top rolls off, distortion + hiss rise), Amount 9 (heavy saturation/compression), Speed Stability dialed into wow/flutter, Noise ON, HF Trim CUT for a dark vintage tone.
intended_for: individual tracks/loops wanting degraded vintage character (drums, synths, guitars, vocal FX). Not for the master bus.
plugin_build: Softube 'Tape.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE — authorized on this rig, re-verify elsewhere). String-enum params → this harness only.
notes: speed_stability runs STABLE(top) -> '99.9'..'0.1' -> WOBBLY; '50.0' = moderate wow/flutter (pitch + level wobble). Lower number = more wobble; use 'WOBBLY' for extreme. This is modulation — spectra barely show it, judge by ear.
For the most extreme lo-fi use tape_speed '1 7/8 IPS' (darkest/crunchiest). Noise grows louder + bassier as speed drops — that's intended here.
Heavy saturation here (Amount 9) collapses crest and adds 3rd-harmonic grit by design. A/B against dry; back off Amount/Noise/Stability to taste.
